family_definition: Plain ASCII digits and letters only; Greek letters, font variants and remaining math tokens are counted in math_symbols, matching the frozen prior audit rule.
interpretation: Class-uniform sampling does not preserve the real TRAIN population mixture. Digits receive about 65% of their population-frequency exposure; ASCII letters about 4.22 times. Math exposure is LOWER than its TRAIN fraction, so symbol-overexposure relative to TRAIN is not supported. This does not establish the cause of owned-input regression or the actual application distribution.
